component.description: Power Metal Strip 4-terminal Kelvin current-sense shunt resistor, 2512 size, 5 mOhm (0.005 Ohm), +/-1% tolerance (F), +/-35 ppm/degC terminated TCR (0.005 to 0.2 Ohm bin), 1.0 W rated dissipation at 70 degC, solid manganese-copper / nickel-chrome alloy element with low element TCR (< 20 ppm/degC) and very low inductance, AEC-Q200 qualified (lead (Pb)-free tape/reel, code EA). Non-polar four-terminal Kelvin device: I1/I2 carry the current (force), E1/E2 (canonical sense S1/S2) tap the voltage across the element.

pinout.name: I1
pinout.description: Current (force) terminal 1. Carries the sensed current; interchangeable with I2.

pinout.name: I2
pinout.description: Current (force) terminal 2. Carries the sensed current; interchangeable with I1.

pinout.name: E1
pinout.description: Voltage-sense (Kelvin) terminal, marked E1 on the datasheet; canonical sense function S1. Taps the voltage across the metal element, isolated from the force-path IR drop.

pinout.name: E2
pinout.description: Voltage-sense (Kelvin) terminal, marked E2 on the datasheet; canonical sense function S2. Taps the voltage across the metal element, isolated from the force-path IR drop.

measurements.conditionsVerbatim: 5 mOhm nominal (value code 5L000 = 0.005 Ohm), 4-terminal Kelvin measurement, 25 degC reference
measurements.sourceTable: Standard Electrical Specifications / Global Part Number Information

measurements.conditionsVerbatim: Tolerance code F = +/- 1.0 % (4-terminal design allows 1 % down to 0.0005 Ohm)

Temperature coefficient +/- 35 ppm/degC for the 0.005 Ohm to 0.2 Ohm resistance bin (applicable bin for this 0.005 Ohm value). Datasheet also lists +/-75 for 0.003-0.0049 Ohm, +/-250 for 0.001-0.0029 Ohm, +/-350 for 0.0005-0.00099 Ohm.
Solid metal nickel-chrome or manganese-copper alloy resistive element with low TCR (< 20 ppm/degC) - the alloy element TCR, distinct from the terminated-part TCR that includes the terminals.
Power rating P70degC = 1.0 W, at 70 degC ambient
Derating curve: 100 % of rated power up to 70 degC ambient
Derating curve: linear taper to 0 % of rated power at 170 degC ambient
Maximum working voltage = (P x R)^1/2 = sqrt(1.0 W x 0.005 Ohm) = 0.0707 V (computed from rated power and this nominal resistance)
Very low inductance 0.5 nH to 5 nH (series-wide range across resistance values)

Load life: 1000 h at rated power, +70 degC, 1.5 h ON / 0.5 h OFF; test limit +/- 1.0 % + 0.0005 Ohm (percent tolerance-band drift captured; the additive 0.0005 Ohm floor term is not representable in %)
Operating temperature range -65 degC to +170 degC
